items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Add products to your bag, open checkout, enter your contact and delivery details and place the order. You can check out as a guest or with an account. You will get a confirmation email with your order number straight away.

items.q: Do I need an account to order?
items.a: No — guest checkout works for everything. An account saves your details, shows your order history and keeps your wishlist across devices.

items.q: Is there a minimum order?
items.a: No. Orders over {free} get free delivery; smaller orders pay a flat {fee}.

items.q: Why is there a limit on how many I can buy?
items.a: Some medicines have per-order limits for safety and to keep stock fair for everyone. The limit is shown on the product page and in your bag.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Yes, any time before it is dispatched. Call {phone} or email {email} with your order number. Cancelling before dispatch is free.

items.q: An item I want is sold out. What can I do?
items.a: Product pages and your bag suggest in-stock alternatives, starting with the same active ingredient (“same salt, other brand”). You can also save it to your wishlist and check back later.

items.q: How long does delivery take?
items.a: Major cities (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi) usually receive orders in 1–3 business days; other areas in 2–5 business days. Orders confirmed before 2 PM are generally dispatched the same day.

items.q: How much is delivery?
items.a: Free on orders over {free}. Below that, a flat {fee}, wherever you are. The fee is always shown before you place the order.

items.q: Where can I track my order?
items.a: Use the Track order page with your order number and the email you used at checkout. Signed-in customers can follow every order from their account.

items.q: Do you deliver everywhere?
items.a: We deliver to all areas served by our courier partners, which covers nearly every city and town. Remote areas can take a day or two longer.

items.q: What if I am not home when the rider arrives?
items.a: The rider calls before arriving. If you are unavailable the courier re-attempts delivery; after failed attempts the parcel comes back to us and we contact you to re-arrange.

items.q: Are temperature-sensitive products handled properly?
items.a: Yes. Heat-sensitive items are packed with insulation and routed for the shortest transit time. If anything arrives damaged, do not use it — tell us within 48 hours.

items.q: How do I pay?
items.a: All orders are cash on delivery. Please check that the parcel is sealed before paying, and pay only the amount on your invoice.

items.q: Are prices final? Do they include tax?
items.a: Prices are in PKR and include applicable taxes. What you see at checkout — items, discounts and delivery — is what you pay at the door.

items.q: How do discounts work?
items.a: Sale prices are applied automatically and shown with the saving on the product and in your bag. There are no codes to remember.

items.q: Will I get an invoice?
items.a: Yes. Your confirmation email lists every item and price, and a printed invoice is included in the parcel.

items.q: Which products need a prescription?
items.a: Products marked “Rx” are prescription-only medicines. You attach the prescription at checkout or upload it from the Upload prescription page, and a pharmacist reviews it before dispatch.

items.q: What makes a prescription valid?
items.a: It must be legible, dated and signed by a registered prescriber, and show the patient’s name and the medicine, strength and dosage. A clear photo or PDF is fine.

items.q: Is my prescription kept private?
items.a: Yes. Prescriptions are stored on private storage that is never publicly accessible and are only viewed by our pharmacists to fulfil your order.

items.q: Can the pharmacist suggest a substitute?
items.a: If a prescribed brand is out of stock, the pharmacist may suggest an equivalent with the same salt and strength. Nothing is substituted without your approval.

items.q: What if my prescription cannot be verified?
items.a: We will call you first. If it still cannot be verified, the prescription items are cancelled and you are not charged for them; the rest of the order can still ship.

items.q: Can I return a product?
items.a: Unopened, room-temperature items in original packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery. For safety, opened medicines, cold-chain items and opened personal-care products cannot be returned unless they arrived damaged or incorrect.

items.q: My order arrived damaged or wrong. What now?
items.a: Contact us within 48 hours with your order number and a photo. We replace the item or refund you in full, including delivery, and collect the item at no cost.

items.q: How do refunds work with cash on delivery?
items.a: Approved refunds are sent by bank transfer or to a mobile wallet (such as JazzCash or Easypaisa) within 5–7 business days.

items.q: Why can’t I return opened medicine?
items.a: Once a medicine has left our controlled storage and been opened we cannot guarantee how it was stored, so it can never be resold safely.

items.q: Are your products authentic?
items.a: We source only through recognised distributors and manufacturers. Every item is sealed and batch-checked, and we check expiry dates before dispatch.

items.q: How do I know a medicine is right for me?
items.a: Product pages show uses, dosage, precautions and warnings for reference, but they are not medical advice. Ask your doctor or our pharmacists — contact us any time during {hours}.

items.q: What is the body map?
items.a: An interactive 3D guide: tap where it hurts, choose a symptom and see self-care tips, warning signs and products our pharmacists would suggest. It helps you navigate the store; it does not diagnose. In an emergency call 1122.

items.q: What does “same salt, other brand” mean?
items.a: Different brands often contain the same active ingredient (the “salt” or generic) at the same strength. We show these side by side so you can choose by price or availability.

items.q: How do I reset my password?
items.a: Choose “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page and enter your email. We send a secure reset link that expires after 60 minutes.

items.q: How does the wishlist work?
items.a: Tap the heart on any product. Guests’ wishlists are saved on the device; when you sign in they are merged into your account. From the wishlist, “Move to bag” adds an item to your bag in one tap.

items.q: Can I save something in my bag for later?
items.a: Yes — choose “Save for later” on any item in your bag and it moves to your wishlist.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Email {email} from the address on your account and we will delete it. Records we are legally required to keep (such as invoices) are retained only for that purpose.

items.q: Do you sell my data?
items.a: Never. We share only what is needed with service providers that help us run the store — for example the courier who delivers your parcel.

items.q: Do you store card details?
items.a: No. Orders are paid in cash on delivery, so we never ask for or store card details.

items.q: Why do some forms show a reCAPTCHA?
items.a: Google reCAPTCHA protects sign-in, checkout and contact forms from bots and abuse, which keeps your account and our stock safe.
